messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
From which date does Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 on machinery apply in general (apart from the provisions that Article 54 brings forward)?

response.text: Da quale data si applica, in generale, il regolamento (UE) 2023/1230 sui macchinari (fatte salve le disposizioni anticipate dall'articolo 54)?
